backend/main.mo: Defines user profiles, daily tracking, badges, chat records, and reset logic with authorization mixins and time-based evaluation.
feature_evidence.json: Describes feature evidence for publishing Draft Version 21, listing related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Contains prewritten summaries of multiple frontend files for reference or documentation.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment guide detailing steps and checklists for releasing Draft Version 21 to production on the Internet Computer.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind-based global style definitions including OKLCH variables, light/dark themes, and base utility adjustments.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the root element and main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app configuring routing, authentication gating, layout, and profile setup flow.
frontend/src/components/AdminPanel.tsx: Simple admin panel card indicating administrator privileges.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: Badge display component showing streak-based badges with optional sparkles, animations, and placeholders.
frontend/src/components/ChatDialog.tsx: Provides a chat dialog with user list, message history, and sending messages via mutations, with auto-scroll and Internet Identity integration.
frontend/src/components/DailyReminder.ts: Shows a timed daily reminder if the user hasn't completed 5 problems, with dismissal persistence in localStorage.
frontend/src/components/DailyTracker.tsx: Displays and updates the user's daily problem completion count with checkboxes and backend syncing.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders a simple footer with attribution and a link to caffeine.ai.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Renders the main header with navigation, theme toggle, authentication controls, user greeting, and chat access.
Shows a sorted daily history timeline with cumulative stats, including loading, error, and empty states.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Displays the login screen with Internet Identity authentication and a feature overview.
frontend/src/components/MotivationalQuot: Displays a card with a randomly selected motivational programming quote on mount.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Renders a modal for entering a user name and creating a profile, with a success animation after submission.
frontend/src/components/ProgressChart.ts: Fetches daily history and displays cumulative progress in a line chart with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/StatsCard.tsx: Shows user profile info and key statistics in a grid, handling loading and missing-profile states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor based on Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and utilities for managing Internet Identity login, state, and persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for interacting with the backend actor, including user profile, account checks, daily problems, and admin-related queries with dynamic refetch intervals.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind CSS layers, theme variables for light and dark modes, and custom animation utilities.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with Internet Identity and React Query providers.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Renders the main user dashboard with stats, daily tracking, admin panel access, and animated UI states depending on user profile loading.
frontend/src/pages/Leaderboard.tsx: Displays sorted user statistics with charts, badges, refresh tracking, and memoized components for performance.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters for routing and state persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config enabling dark mode, custom color tokens, extended shadows, keyframes, and using typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project metadata, versions, and existing features for a deployment workflow tracking system.
